title: Brand new! Steps to Broadway! WiFi, Parking, Pool
description:
Welcome to Downtown Nashville and enjoy your stay in a centrally located suite!
We are within minutes of many attractions and conference centers.
Enjoy the property’s amenities such as the pool, gym, and more.

Airport is 15mins away

Parking $30 per night 

Permit 2018071

The space
The unit comfortably accommodates 6 guests.
There is a queen size bed in the bedroom.
There is a queen size sofa bed in the living room.
There is a full size bed in the living room as well.

There is a working station available. 

50 inch Smart TV available to use for your streaming apps.

Kitchen and Bathroom are equipped with basic essentials.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire unit and all of the property’s amenities.

Other things to note
The entire building is operated by DOOR smart lock system.
Upon reservation, guest will provide their email to be set up for DOOR access. 

Guest must list all other guest names in their reservation details.
